content: The INLINEFORM0 parameter in the calculation of PARENT decides whether to compute recall against the table or the reference (Eq. EQREF22 ). Figure FIGREF50 shows the distribution of the values taken by INLINEFORM1 using the heuristic described in § SECREF3 for instances in both WikiBio and WebNLG. For WikiBio, the recall of the references against the table is generally low, and hence the recall of the generated text relies more on the table. For WebNLG, where the references are elicited from humans, this recall is much higher (often INLINEFORM2 ), and hence the recall of the generated text relies more on the reference.
